title: The Last First: Winter K2
plot_overview: A historic winter race to reach the summit of K2 becomes increasingly dangerous as ambition, ego, and the pursuit of glory collide with the mountain’s extreme conditions. The expedition faces a devastating turn that tests the limits of endurance and human determination.
will_you_like_this: You may enjoy this if you like gripping survival stories, perilous mountain challenges, and serious human drama; Not for you if you prefer lighthearted adventures or low-stakes competition.
review_summary: Pros: high-stakes premise; extreme setting; intense ambition | Cons: potentially bleak; emotionally heavy
